description: List messages in a mailbox. Defaults to INBOX, limit 20. Set preview to ~200 for agent scan workflows to avoid N+1 mail_show calls.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from a previous response.

fields.description: Comma-separated JSON field names to include (e.g. id,subject,from). Trims the payload to fewer tokens.

limit.description: Maximum messages to return (default: 20; capped at 500).

preview.description: Include a plain-text body preview of up to N chars per message (forces per-message IMAP fetch; use ~200 for scan workflows).

title: mail_list: arguments
